newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial files $500 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial files $500 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday a shelf registration for up to $500 million in debt securities, preferred stock, depositary shares, common stock, securities warrants and units.
The company said net proceeds will be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
Based in Minneapolis, Minn., Olympic Financial sells and services retail automobile loans originated from a network of automobile dealers from whom the company buys such loans.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
